map.由期望损失与暴露单位求纯费率 使用指南: Pure Rate from Expected Loss and Exposure Units User Guide
map.输入组合的总期望损失与风险暴露单位数，按纯费率 = 期望损失 ÷ 暴露单位计算每: Enter the combined expected loss and the number of risk exposure units to compute the pure rate per unit of risk as expected loss / exposure units, used as the base rate for non-life pricing.
map.纯费率 = 期望损失/暴露单位: Pure rate = expected loss / exposure units
map.输入期望损失与风险暴露单位数，求纯费率。: Enter the expected loss and the number of risk exposure units to get the pure rate.
map.由期望损失除以暴露单位得每单位纯费率。: Divide the expected loss by the exposure units to get the pure rate per unit.
map.做费率厘定的最底层依据。: The bottom layer underpinning rate setting.
map.：纯费率 = 1000/100 = 10/单位。即每暴露单位纯保费 10 元。: Pure rate = 1000/100 = 10 per unit. That is, the pure premium is 10 CNY per exposure unit.
map.由保单准备金与退保比例求现金价值: Cash value from policy reserves and the surrender ratio
map.由生存人数求 t 年生存概率: t-year survival probability from the number surviving
map.由综合成本率反推承保利润: Back out underwriting profit from the combined cost ratio
map.纯费率和毛费率差？: What's the Difference Between the Pure and Gross Rate?
map.纯费率只覆盖期望损失；毛费率 = 纯费率×(1+附加费率)，再加费用利润安全边际: The pure rate covers expected loss only; the gross rate = pure rate x (1 + loading factor), then add expenses, profit and a safety margin.
map.纯费率能直接对外报价吗？: Can the Pure Rate Be Quoted Directly?
map.不能。纯费率是每单位暴露的风险成本，对外报价要在其上加附加费率（费用加利润加税）: No. The pure rate is the risk cost per unit of exposure; an external quote must add a loading factor (expenses plus profit plus tax) to get the gross rate. The pure rate is only a starting point for pricing.
